title: 英国：警方调查中国大使馆警卫在伦敦用电击棒恐吓西藏活动人士
content: cross-posted from：https://scribe.disroot.org/post/10234513 cross-posted from：https://scribe.disroot.org/post/10234333>伦敦警察厅已对中国驻伦敦大使馆安保人员在烛光守夜活动中挥舞高压电击棒（英国法律列为违禁武器）威胁和平西藏示威者的指控展开调查。这一事件加剧了人们对所谓跨国镇压的担忧，并重新审视了中国拟在英国首都设立的大型大使馆。> >调查发生在7月3日晚上，当时有报道称，有人看到中国大使馆安保人员在伦敦市中心的波特兰广场（Portland Place）举行的一次和平集会上使用了带电的电击棒。> >这场守夜活动是由英国的藏人社区和人权支持者一起组织的，目的是纪念洛迦让增，2026年7月2日，这位藏独活动人士在纽约联合国总部外自焚身亡。> >总部位于伦敦的倡导组织“自由西藏”在其社交媒体平台上发布了一段广为流传的视频。

The complaints were raised before the Kahama District Security Committee during an inspection visit to the mine after a video circulated showing some workers allegedly collecting human waste in buckets and dumping it in an open area. The workers claimed they were working without employment contracts, personal protective equipment (PPE), adequate rest periods and in unsafe conditions, while fearing dismissal if they raised concerns. ... Some also accused Chinese supervisors of harassment, alleging that workers were threatened with job losses and delayed salaries whenever they complained . ... One of the workers, Amos Daudi, said many employees had worked at the mine without contracts, leaving them afraid to speak out over their grievances. “Many workers here do not have employment contracts. title: 中国大使重申支持巴勒斯坦
content: 2026年8月8日，中国驻巴勒斯坦国大使孙振重申，中国将坚定不移地支持巴勒斯坦事业，继续提供人道主义和发展援助，致力于将巴中关系提升到新的水平。8月1日，在中国驻拉马拉大使馆举行的新闻发布会上，他说，他与巴勒斯坦领导人的会晤使他更加了解巴勒斯坦人民面临的困难，强调中国将继续加强双边关系，特别是今年是中华人民共和国成立三周年，巴勒斯坦战略伙伴关系。他补充说，中国正在约旦河西岸实施发展项目，包括人造草坪、中文学校、北京街、和巴中友谊广场。孙振重申了中国对巴勒斯坦民族权利的支持，表示中国支持在1967年边界内建立一个拥有完全主权和独立的巴勒斯坦国，以耶路撒冷为首都。中国拒绝所有我

title_en: Chinese Ambassador Reiterates Support for Palestine
title_zh: 中国大使重申支持巴勒斯坦
content_en: By Friends of Socialist – Aug 8, 2026 Chinese Ambassador to the State of Palestine Sun Zhen has reaffirmed China’s unwavering commitment to supporting the Palestinian cause, continuing to provide humanitarian and development assistance, and working to elevate Palestinian-Chinese relations to new levels. Speaking at a press conference held at the Chinese embassy in Ramallah on August 1, he said that his meetings with the Palestinian leadership had reinforced his awareness of the hardships facing the Palestinian people, stressing that China will continue strengthening bilateral ties, particularly as this year marks the third anniversary of the establishment of the China-Palestine strategic partnership. He added that China is working on implementing development projects in the West Bank, including infrastructure projects such as artificial turf fields, a Chinese school, Beijing Street, and the Palestinian-Chinese Friendship Square. Sun Zhen reiterated his country’s support for Palestinian national rights, stating that China supports the establishment of a fully sovereign and independent Palestinian state within the 1967 borders, with East Jerusalem as its capital. content_en: cross-posted from: https://mander.xyz/post/56132298 Here is the study: Democratic Republic of Congo: Expansion of Chinese-Owned Cobalt and Copper Mines in the Lualaba Province - Researchers used commercial satellite imagery to document major expansion at three Chinese-controlled DRC [Democratic Republic of the Congo] mines: Sicomines, Tenke Fungurume, and Kisanfu. - Evidence shows China is building an integrated upstream ecosystem combining extraction, processing, logistics, and transportation—not merely increasing raw output. - Cobalt is critical for aerospace, defense, and advanced batteries, making China's tightening grip a serious strategic concern for Western nations. - Satellite analysis cannot directly measure production volumes, and the study is limited to three operations, leaving broader industry trends unexamined. .... The risks of human rights violations in these mines are extremely high .
